dct_description_sm:
The Place of Work files are available at the Municipality and Census Tract levels of geography.

The Municipality file contains the following data: Total employed labour force living at Location A; Living at Location A working at home; Living at Location A working outside Canada; Living at Location A place of work not stated; Living at Location A working outside Location A; Total employed labour force working at Location A; Working at Location A living outside Location A; Living at Location A working at Location B; Living at Location B working at Location A.

The Census Tract file contains the following data: Employed labour force by sex living at Location A; Employed labour force by sex working at Location A; Employed labour force by sex living at Location B; Employed labour force by sex working at Location B; Employed labour force by sex living at Location A and working at Location B; Employed labour force by sex living at Location B and working at Location A.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
